SpearmintLOVE Review - Must Read This Before Buying

# SpearmintLOVE Review

Table of Contents

## About SpearmintLOVE

SpearmintLOVE is the online shop you go to when searching for adorable, unique styles. Specializing in collections for your little one’s first year, you’ll find a sweet selection of apparel, accessories, and soft toys to create the cutest memories.

A hub of 140+ unique and budding brands, as well as its signature collection, SpearmintLOVE is adored for its variety of thousands of products. Just ask its social community of almost 3 million followers, or consult features in popular publications like Cosmopolitan, WWD, and USA Today.

Need to know everything about this brand, and like, now? It’s all coming up in this SpearmintLOVE review. I’ll take a close look at the company and its bestsellers before checking out customer reviews and promotions. Let’s dive in.

## Overview of SpearmintLOVE

The story of SpearmintLOVE starts with a blogger named Shari Lott. After creating a well-known name for her baby blog, SpearmintBaby, she set out in search of a USA-made Swiss Cross blanket and found nothing. So she made the equivalent herself.

SpearmintLOVE started out with just two products on its website and has grown to offer over 5,000. And this happened in the span of just a few years. Growing rapidly within her first 4 years of business, by 2017 Shari found herself as part of Facebook’s U.S. Small Business Council, guiding small businesses to help them grow.

So what makes SpearmintLOVE one of the fastest-growing baby brands to ever exist? It has a lot to do with the interesting brands and unique products it brings on board. Connecting moms and businesses with something special to offer, the shop helps smaller brands gain exposure and grow.

Ready to see the kind of quality it delivers? In this SpearmintLOVE review, I’ll run you through its highlights before checking out some of the brand’s best-sellers.

### Highlights

- Sells 5,000+ products (apparel, accessories, toys, and more)
- 140+ brands
- 10% coupon code available
- Sale section
- Ships internationally
- Free standard US shipping

Whether it’s you, your cousin, or your brother’s girlfriend’s best friend that’s having a baby, hopping on to SpearmintLOVE’s website means you won’t leave empty-handed. With collections that evoke tiny squeals of delight, you’ll browse through apparel, outerwear, and accessories for boys and girls.

The website lets you shop by holiday or by brand, and if modern neutrals and trendy styles are your thing, hit up the brand’s signature line. Since this is a SpearmintLOVE review, I’ll focus on a few items from the brand’s house line, but you’ll discover some adorable Taggies toys here too.

# I have a concern about my order: should I contact SpearmintLOVE first or file a dispute?

We are sorry to hear you are experiencing an issue. We understand you want a resolution as quickly as possible.

Your experience at SpearmintLOVE is extremely important to us. To best serve you, please contact customer service first to share your concern. Communicating with our service team directly gives us the chance to work out a mutually agreeable solution and is often faster than filing a chargeback.

Please note that once a dispute is open with your bank or credit card company, our customer service team can no longer handle the issue directly, which includes our ability to refund or reship an order.

# Why was my order canceled?

If you have received a refund email for an order placed, this does mean that an item from your order was canceled. We sincerely apologize for this disappointment! This happens when there is a discrepancy in stock, meaning the product was not available when your order was being picked by our team.

This email confirms that a refund has already been issued to your original form of payment for the out of stock item(s). The refund will appear back in your account in about 1-3 business days (can vary depending on your bank).
